strategy_params.rewritten_instructions:
Choose the operational action for an incoming business email.
Apply this policy exactly. REPLY: needs a routine response; ARCHIVE: informational or unsolicited; ESCALATE: requires authority or urgent handling. Resolve boundary cases using the class definitions, not label position.

Classify the permitted disclosure level of an email.
Apply this policy exactly. PUBLIC: safe for public distribution; INTERNAL: company-only routine material; CONFIDENTIAL: secrets, personal data, or privileged material. Resolve boundary cases using the class definitions, not label position.

Choose an energy-management response to a household condition.
Apply this policy exactly. REDUCE: lower consumption now; SHIFT: defer flexible work; NO_ACTION: leave operation unchanged. Resolve boundary cases using the class definitions, not label position.

Choose how a smart-home controller should handle an event.
Apply this policy exactly. NOTIFY: human awareness is needed; AUTOMATE: safe predefined action; IGNORE: benign noise. Resolve boundary cases using the class definitions, not label position.

Assign operational severity to a system event.
Apply this policy exactly. INFO: normal operation; WARN: degradation needing attention; CRITICAL: active outage or data loss. Resolve boundary cases using the class definitions, not label position.

Route an infrastructure event to the owning subsystem.
Apply this policy exactly. NETWORK: connectivity and DNS; STORAGE: disks, databases, and persistence; AUTH: credentials and authorization. Resolve boundary cases using the class definitions, not label position.

Assess fraud risk for an online order.
Apply this policy exactly. ALLOW: ordinary low-risk purchase; REVIEW: suspicious but inconclusive; BLOCK: strong evidence of abuse. Resolve boundary cases using the class definitions, not label position.

Decide whether a merchandise return is allowed under policy.
Apply this policy exactly. ELIGIBLE: within policy; INELIGIBLE: clearly outside policy; REVIEW: exception or insufficient evidence. Resolve boundary cases using the class definitions, not label position.

Classify support tickets by whether immediate human intervention is required.
Apply this policy exactly. URGENT: outage, security, or material financial harm; NORMAL: routine help without immediate harm. Resolve boundary cases using the class definitions, not label position.

Route a customer request to the responsible support team.
Apply this policy exactly. BILLING: payments and invoices; TECHNICAL: product failures; ACCOUNT: identity and access settings. Resolve boundary cases using the class definitions, not label position.
